scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @finora/shared && npm run build -w @finora/db && npm run build -w @finora/domain
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @finora/api
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @finora/api && npm run build -w @finora/web
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test -w @finora/domain && npm run test -w @finora/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
